description: Finish adding a tool to Agent Charts, after add_service and after its value is published on the tool's domain. Agent Charts looks for the value on the domain and, if it is there, files the entry: it is read and then shows at agentcharts.xyz/sellers/<domain>/, usually within the hour. Leave the file or the DNS record in place until it shows. An error that the value wasn't found, or that today's places are taken, leaves the code working: call again later with the same code and token, not in a loop. Adding a domain again replaces its earlier entry. Free, no sign-in.

email.description: The owner's contact email, only if the owner gives one. Kept private and never shown

token.description: The private token add_service returned with that code

name: finish_add
